request: Improve toward almost all heart rates within error tolerance
population: Six previously inspected personal recordings; development, not held-out validation
candidate_families: Log-RGB chromatic projection with fixed common-mode illumination removal
One fixed public EfficientPhys PURE checkpoint with documented 30Hz input adapter
parameter_policy: Freeze each implementation from physical models and synthetic tests before real-reference scoring. Record any later revisions explicitly. No truth-guided ROI/frequency routing, no per-video threshold or reference offset search.
success_distinction: Promoting a partial improvement does not mean the user's near-all-within-5bpm objective is met. Report each case separately and state unmet objectives.
oracle_policy: Any truth-near candidate availability is diagnostic only, must be clearly marked not a deployable result and must never determine an inference frequency.
preservation: Keep V25 recommended entry and all previous outputs
Preserve original videos and Polar data
Pixel tracking, local screening and fallback remain in original branch
Missing waveform/HR not replaced with zero or carried HR
Never synthesize a pulse from reference HR
Local inference only; no video upload
